sources_considered.why: Shows repeated protected-symbol errors and subsequent changes of variable names.
Documents another reserved-symbol error and seven unsuccessful calls attributed tentatively to name conflicts.
Reports broader interface failures without a syntax-specific frequency audit.

evidence_items.publisher: New York University; Scott Aaronson and Ernest Davis
evidence_items.explanation: GPT-4 twice assigns to protected symbol E, receives explicit errors, and changes identifiers. This verifies recurrence within one problem, but the local corrections do not establish an unrecovered syntax failure.

evidence_items.publisher: New York University; Ernest Davis and Scott Aaronson
evidence_items.locator: Problem 26, page 31; reserved-symbol example also in problem 10
evidence_items.explanation: Problem 26 reports seven failed calls, apparently caused by variable-name conflicts, but omits the calls needed to confirm that diagnosis. Problem 10 separately documents replacing a reserved variable before encountering a different failure.

unresolved_gaps: No complete count of syntax-related failures across problems or calls.
The strongest unrecovered example has a tentative diagnosis and omitted calls.
Visible reserved-symbol errors sometimes receive local corrections.
